children.html:
Ordering weed delivery in DC is straightforward once you know how the system works. This guide walks you through the whole process from placing your first order to receiving it at your door, so you know exactly what to expect before you buy. Whether you’re a first-time buyer or new to ordering online, here’s everything you need to know.

Is Weed Delivery Legal in DC?

Yes. Cannabis delivery in Washington, DC, is legal under Initiative 71, a law passed by DC voters that permits the gifting of cannabis between adults 21 and older. When you order from a service like Lifted Shop, your transaction is structured as a lawful gift under DC law.

You do not need a medical marijuana card. You do not need a prescription. You need to be 21 or older with a valid ID.

For a full breakdown of the law and what it means for buyers, read: DC Weed Gifting: How Initiative 71 Works.

What You Need Before You Order

Before placing your first order, make sure you have the following:

  • Valid government-issued photo ID confirming you are 21 or older. A driver’s license, passport, or state ID all work.
  • A DC delivery address or a pickup plan if you’d prefer to collect in person.
  • A minimum order of $100 for same-day delivery within Washington, DC.
  • Someone 21+ present at the delivery address to receive the order and show ID.

That’s it. No membership, no account history, no referral needed.

Step-by-Step: How to Place a Delivery Order

Step 1: Browse the menu
Visit the Lifted Shop menu online and browse available products. You’ll find flower, pre-rolls, edibles, cartridges, concentrates, live resin, and shrooms. Everything listed is available for same-day delivery.

Step 2: Add to your order
 Select the products you want. Keep in mind the $100 minimum for DC delivery.

Step 3: Place your order
 Check out online. You’ll receive a confirmation once your order is placed.

Step 4: Wait for your delivery
 A driver heads your way from our location at 2622 Georgia Ave NW. Most DC addresses receive their order within 1–2 hours.

Step 5: Receive your order
 Have your ID ready. The driver will verify you are 21+ before handing over the order. That’s all there is to it.

How to Order for Pickup Instead

Prefer to collect your order rather than wait for delivery? Here’s how pickup works:

  1. Browse the menu and place your order online, the same process as delivery
  2. Select pickup at checkout
  3. Head to 2622 Georgia Ave NW, Washington, DC, when your order is confirmed ready
  4. Show your ID and collect your order

Note: Lifted Shop does not operate as a walk-in retail store. You cannot browse products in person. All orders must be placed online before you arrive.

Delivery Hours and Areas

Delivery hours: Daily, 10 am – 9 pm
Delivery area: Washington DC
Estimated delivery time: 1–2 hours from 2622 Georgia Ave NW
Minimum order: $100

Orders placed before 9 pm are eligible for same-day delivery. Orders placed after 9 pm will be fulfilled the following day from 10 am.

We also deliver to select areas in Maryland and Virginia. Delivery times and minimums may vary outside DC.

What Products Can I Order?

Everything on the Lifted Shop menu is available for delivery or pickup. Current product categories include:

  • Flower: Premium indoor strains
  • Pre-rolls: Standard and infused options. Shop pre-rolls
  • Edibles: Gummies, chocolates, and infused treats
  • Vape cartridges: 510-thread and all-in-one formats. Shop cartridges
  • Concentrates: Shatter, wax, crumble, RSO, and tinctures. Shop concentrates
  • Live resin and premium extracts: Raw and cart form. Shop live resin
  • Shrooms: Psilocybin products available for delivery and pickup. Shop shrooms

Inventory rotates. Check the live menu for current availability.
